GRADE 9 ENGLISH — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the degrees of comparison in adverbs,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs.

2. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use positive, comparative and superlative degrees of adverbs in sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs.

3. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the degrees of comparison in adverbs,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs.

5. About Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the themes in a play or a section of a play,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play completely.
   C. Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play.

6. About Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. analyse the themes in a play,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play completely.
   C. Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play.

7. About Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. relate the themes in a play to real life,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play completely.
   C. Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play.

9. About Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ completely.
   C. Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ.

10. About Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ completely.
   C. Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ.

11. About Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ completely.
   C. Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Spelling 7.5.1 The writing process -Steps 8.5.1 Assessing writing 9.5.1 Narrativ.

13. About Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise homonyms, homophones, double consonants and double vowels in written texts,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling completely.
   C. Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.

14. About Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. spell commonly misspelt words for writing fluency,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling completely.
   C. Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.

15. About Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise homonyms, homophones, double consonants and double vowels in written texts,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling completely.
   C. Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.

17. About Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. outline words and phrases used to express euphemism,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail.

18. About Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use euphemism to show politeness in communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail.

19. About Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. conduct a debate while adhering to conventions of polite language,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Listening for Detail.

21. About Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. distinguish between reading for interpretation and reading for evaluation of information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation.

   A. interpret a reading text for lifelong learning,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation.

23. About Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. summarise information in a reading text,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Interpretation and Evaluation.

25. About Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Relative Pronouns: Interrogative Pronouns in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise relative and interrogative pronouns in a text,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Relative Pronouns: Interrogative Pronouns completely.
